title: finance.compliance.eway_bill.generation_requested
description: A command to finance's own worker: make another attempt at raising one document's e-Way bill. Handed to the scheduler with a not_before for the automatic retry after an outage (trigger retry) and published directly for a person's retry now (trigger manual). chain_id names the generation chain the retry belongs to, so a retry that arrives after the chain has moved on or ended is recognised as stale and does nothing. The consumer claims, calls the portal with no transaction open, and records; the transport facts are read from the ledger, never from this message.
